title: Tucker logical expert bank with one phase Mirror address
hypothesis: For a 64-expert linear MoE bank with 48 experts on a shared eight-harmonic coefficient orbit, one stored phase per aligned expert plus a shared Tucker matrix bank will reduce complete serialized bytes by at least 10% versus rank-16 free Tucker coefficients with the same private fallback rule while preserving held-out function nMSE <=1e-4; off-orbit experts will require private state.
physical_object: one shared 32x16 matrix bank (16 fixed random orthonormal matrix atoms plus shared mean) used to reconstruct 64 logical top-1 experts
mirror_coordinate: one FP16 phase per expert; shared amplitudes produce coefficient pairs [a_h*cos(h*phase), a_h*sin(h*phase)] for h=1..8
logical_multiplicity: 48 aligned expert functions from the shared phase orbit; 16 unrelated expert functions may receive private full-matrix fallback

task.amplitude_rule: shared amplitude a_h=0.25/sqrt(h), h=1..8; charged in payload
task.private_gate: if validation task nMSE > 1e-4, store that task's full FP16 matrix as private fallback
task.task_id: oracle top-1 expert index, uint8 task-index table charged in each payload; router training and routing quality are out of scope

controls: free Tucker coefficient banks of rank 1/2/4/8/16 over identical shared atoms
rank-16 Tucker plus validation-selected private full-matrix fallback
Mirror phase address plus the same private fallback rule

selection.development: fixed conditions only; no hyperparameter tuning allowed
selection.fresh: seeds 32011/32012/32013 locked until frozen source and protocol are committed

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: fixed-timestamp ZIP containing sorted NPY tensors, uncompressed
paid_objects: shared mean and all matrix atoms
all direct coefficients or Fourier amplitudes and expert phases
storage.random_basis: serialized and charged; same shared basis used by all coefficient methods

compute.inference: one expert matrix-vector product per request; no router or materialization counted as free

gates.promising: All fresh seeds: Mirror total package <=0.90x rank16-Tucker+same-private-fallback bytes and every expert test nMSE<=1e-4.
gates.fail: Mirror payload >= direct rank16+same-private control in >=2 seeds, or any private-task quality misses in >=2 seeds.
gates.not_established: serialization/replay mismatch or task split leakage

boundaries: teacher deliberately contains an eight-harmonic phase orbit
no router or learned MoE training claim
logical task count is not independent capacity
